analyst_view.overall: Leaders PSG (1st, 26 pts, five league wins in a row) host Lorient (10th, 16 pts) on Saturday evening, three days after a Champions League home game against Roma tonight. The numbers now take Doue and Kvaratskhelia off PSG's goals, but a lineup site also lists Marquinhos, Dembele, Nuno Mendes and Longoni as out, with Akliouche and Dro Fernandez doubtful; Dembele did play at Nice, so that report is uncertain. With a midweek Champions League game, Luis Enrique usually rotates in the league, and PSG's hot run (21 goals and 58 shots on target in six) is already lifting the numbers. Lorient are without Toure, Katseris and Fadiga (counted by the numbers) and have kept a settled side. Bastien Dechepy referees (4.4 cards a game, already counted); I lean slightly lower on PSG's attacking numbers for rotation.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.7 goals, 1.9 for PSG, already lifted by their 21 goals in six and now trimmed for Doue and Kvaratskhelia. With Roma on Wednesday and more attackers doubtful, a rotated PSG side is likely, so I lean slightly lower, 2.7 to about 2.6; smaller than before because the numbers now count Doue.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.6 corners, 6.6 for PSG. Even a rotated PSG side keeps the ball and pushes Lorient back, and Lorient average only about 8 shots a game, so the corners stay one-sided as the numbers already expect; I stay at about 9.6.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.2 cards: PSG have picked up only 3 cards in their last six, then the numbers add about 16% for referee Bastien Dechepy (4.4 a game). There is no rivalry and nothing at stake beyond the points, so I stay at 3.2.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.6 shots, already boosted about 10% for PSG's run of 105 shots in six. A midweek Champions League game and a long injury list make rotation likely, so I lean slightly lower, 27.6 to about 26.5.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.3 shots on target, with PSG's figure lifted 13% for an unusually sharp run (58 on target in six). A changed PSG front line after Roma is unlikely to keep that pace fully, so I lean slightly lower, 10.3 to about 9.9.
